sourceChecksReportedByReactEngineer.note: These source checks were run by the sole React Engineer; this Visual QA independently ran the browser evidence above.

performance.sampleTimingNote: Latest10s sample was taken after disabled-gesture correction and before the final event-only scroll/focus refinements; those do not run on the sampled idle auth path. The six renderer/SVG files remain identical in the final source.
performance.conclusion: No steady-state regression observed in these single local headless samples. Callback cadence varied substantially; do not attribute lower durations to Motion System, claim a percentage improvement or infer actual display FPS.

video.role: Short sampled visual walkthrough only; not a performance or display-frame-rate measurement.

console.expectedNetworkErrors: Deliberate mocked401 login failures produce expected browser network lines; these are preserved separately in the per-run reports.

limitations: Firefox was not found in the checked installation, command, registry or Playwright cache paths; no browser downloads were attempted.
Mobile viewports/touch and short-height behavior were emulated in Chrome; physical phones, their virtual keyboards and Safari were not tested.
Screen-reader semantics, focus, inert and live errors were inspected; a physical screen reader was not exercised.
Native app reload returned scroll0 in this environment, while no Motion System scroll/focus call ran; this task does not implement global browser scroll restoration.
Headless rAF cadence and sampled video do not measure physically displayed frame rate or total GPU/system load.
